finding: Bank willingness to lend holds steady in Slovakia above EA
bullets: A net 7.8% of Slovak firms (n=310) reported improved bank willingness to provide credit, unchanged from the previous wave and above the EA's net 5.6% (n=6,350) — suggesting stable credit supply conditions.

Access to public financial support improved notably in Slovakia, with the net balance rising from -33.8% to -21.2% (n=310), compared with a marginal easing from -15.5% to -13.6% in the EA — easing pressure on firms reliant on guarantees.
The general economic outlook deteriorated further for a net 51.6% of Slovak firms (n=472), worsening by 7.2 pp from the previous wave and running 22.2 pp below the EA's net 29.4%.
